appointment.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
appointment.exZh: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。

dependent.m: adj. 依靠的；依赖的；n. 受赡养者
dependent.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
dependent.exZh: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。

propose.ex: He proposes to go to the park after lunch.

engagement.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
engagement.exZh: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。

honeymoon.ex: They went to Bali for their honeymoon.

divorce.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
divorce.exZh: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。

single.m: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的
single.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
single.exZh: 他买了一张单程公交车票。

sole.ex: He is the sole owner of the shop.
sole.exZh: 他是这家商店唯一的主人。

respective.ex: Each student received their respective book.
respective.exZh: 每个学生都收到了他们各自的书。

individual.m: n. 个人；adj. 个别的；单独的
individual.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
individual.exZh: 每个人都有权自由发言。

commuter.m: n. 通勤者；经常往返者
commuter.ex: He is a commuter who takes the train to work every day.
commuter.exZh: 他是一名每天乘火车上班的通勤者。

neighbourhood.m: n. 街坊；四邻；附近地区
neighbourhood.ex: We know all our neighbours in this neighbourhood.
neighbourhood.exZh: 我们认识这个街坊里的所有邻居。

boss.ex: My boss gives me work every morning.
boss.exZh: 我的老板每天早上给我安排工作。

supervisor.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
supervisor.exZh: 主管检查了工人们的进展。

subordinate.ex: His opinion is subordinate to the manager's.
subordinate.exZh: 他的意见比经理的次要。

colleague.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
colleague.exZh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。

comrade.ex: He called his friend a comrade.

acquaintance.ex: I met him at a party, but he is only an acquaintance.
acquaintance.exZh: 我在聚会上认识了他，但他只是个熟人。

affection.ex: She showed great affection for her little dog.
affection.exZh: 她对她的小狗非常钟爱。

stranger.m: n. 陌生人；新来者；adj. 比较级词形
stranger.ex: He is a stranger in this town.
stranger.exZh: 他是这个镇上的新来者。

apprentice.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
apprentice.exZh: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。

deputy.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
deputy.exZh: 代理人替经理签署了文件。

hero.ex: The firefighter is a hero for saving the child.
hero.exZh: 消防员救了孩子，是个英雄。

heroine.ex: The heroine saves the town from the dragon.
heroine.exZh: 女主角拯救了小镇免受龙的侵害。

drama.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
drama.exZh: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。

actress.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
actress.exZh: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。

chancellor.ex: The chancellor announced a new tax policy.
chancellor.exZh: 大臣宣布了一项新的税收政策。

commander.ex: The commander gave the order to advance.
commander.exZh: 指挥官下达了前进的命令。

director.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
director.exZh: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。

proponent.m: n. 支持者；拥护者；辩护者
proponent.ex: He is a proponent of clean energy.
proponent.exZh: 他是清洁能源的支持者。

council.m: n. 理事会；委员会；议会
council.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
council.exZh: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。

delegate.ex: The manager will delegate the task to her assistant.
delegate.exZh: 经理将把这个任务委派给她的助手。

specialist.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
specialist.exZh: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。

consultant.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
consultant.exZh: 他是这家大公司的顾问。

veterinary.ex: He works at a veterinary clinic.
veterinary.exZh: 他在一家兽医诊所工作。

counsellor.ex: The school counsellor helped me with my study problems.
counsellor.exZh: 学校的辅导员帮我解决了学习问题。

solicitor.ex: He hired a solicitor to help with his house sale.
solicitor.exZh: 他聘请了一名事务律师来帮助处理他的房屋出售。

attorney.m: n. 律师；辩护律师；代理人
attorney.ex: The attorney helped the man with his case.
attorney.exZh: 律师帮助那个人处理了他的案件。

umpire.ex: The umpire blew the whistle when the player broke the rule.
umpire.exZh: 当球员犯规时，裁判吹响了哨子。

cashier.m: n. 出纳员，收银员；v. 革除（军职）
cashier.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
cashier.exZh: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。

fireman.ex: The fireman saved the cat from the tree.
fireman.exZh: 消防员从树上救下了那只猫。

nurse.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.

bound.m: adj. 一定会；密切相关的；有义务的
bound.ex: He is bound to win the race.

gardener.ex: The gardener waters the plants every morning.
gardener.exZh: 园丁每天早上给植物浇水。

barber.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.

haircut.ex: He got a new haircut yesterday.
haircut.exZh: 他昨天理了一个新发型。

fisherman.ex: The fisherman catches fish every morning.

butcher.m: n. 屠夫；v. 屠宰；糟蹋
butcher.ex: The butcher sold fresh meat at the market.
butcher.exZh: 屠夫在市场卖新鲜的肉。

groom.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
groom.exZh: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。

hostage.ex: The robbers took a hostage during the bank robbery.
hostage.exZh: 劫匪在银行抢劫时抓了一名人质。

toil.ex: He toils in the field every day.
toil.exZh: 他每天在田里辛苦劳作。

beggar.ex: The beggar sat on the street with a cup.
beggar.exZh: 那个乞丐坐在街上，手里拿着一个杯子。

slave.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
slave.exZh: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。

coward.ex: He was a coward and ran away from the fight.
